batch: GC-B6B FRESH CANDIDATE + BLIND SEMANTIC REVIEW

scope.note: The PUBLIC evidence package. A hit in it is a defect of this batch. The scan output itself is excluded from the scan (it would otherwise report its own content) and a final pass over every payload file, this output and the manifest is recorded in finalVerification.

scanner.secretPatterns: scripts/stage_b_b5_3/lib/contracts.mjs :: SECRET_PATTERNS (6 patterns; the literals are not reproduced here because reproducing them would make this file a hit of its own)
scanner.pathDetector: scripts/stage_b_b5_3/lib/privacy.mjs :: detectAbsolutePaths (POSIX one-segment and multi-segment, Windows backslash and forward-slash drive, UNC backslash and forward-slash), with the narrow structured public-route allowlist

forbiddenContentProbes.note: The counts of the strings that may NEVER appear in the public evidence of a blind review. Every count must be zero.

explanations.claims: one occurrence: the COUNT of the material claims of the published derivative (5). A count is allowed; a claim TEXT never appears.
explanations.chapters: three occurrences: the COUNT of the chapters of the published derivative (6) and the chapter count of the capture receipt (0). Counts are allowed; a chapter TEXT never appears.
explanations.evidence/: three occurrences: the REPO-RELATIVE evidence package paths of the candidate lock. They are not private paths, not absolute and not content.

finalVerification.note: The final pass covers EVERY payload file, this scan output and the manifest, after the payloads stabilized.
